critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly saves test email history to email_test_history collection with all required fields
GET /api/admin/email-templates/{id}/test-history returns sorted (DESC by sent_at), limited to 10 records
Frontend fetches testHistoryMap for all templates on load to display last test indicators
Frontend openSendTest() fetches specific template history when opening dialog

formatTimeAgo() correctly converts ISO dates to French relative time strings

seed_data_creation: Used existing templates (rassurant, incitatif, urgent) and created test history entries during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 55 verified test email history tracking feature. Key endpoints: GET /api/admin/email-templates/{id}/test-history returns {history: [{id, template_id, template_name, email, subject, variables_used, status, error, sent_at}], total}. POST /api/admin/email-templates/send-test saves to email_test_history collection. Frontend data-testids: last-test-{name}, no-test-{name} for card indicators; test-history-section, test-history-item-{n} for dialog history display. History is sorted by sent_at DESC, limited to 10 records. Resend sandbox mode causes status='failed' for non-verified addresses - this is EXPECTED BEHAVIOR.

mocked_apis.note: Resend is in sandbox mode - test emails to non-verified addresses return status='failed' but history is still recorded. This is expected behavior.
